    Application
    Declares the application class: its names, as gaia's ApplicationDirectories takes them, and its version.
    ApplicationDescriptor
    The names of an Application class, which the processor generates and registers as a service.

    What the application is and where it runs, bound in the root injector.
    Arguments
    The arguments given to the launch of the application, bound in the root injector.
    DisplayLocale
    The locale of user-interface text, chosen once at startup and bound in the root injector.
    Exit
    Ends the JVM at the end of the shutdown.
    ExitVeto
    Asked before the application exits, on the UiExecutor's thread.
    FailureHandler
    Handles a failure nothing else handles, such as a task's with no onFailure handler.
    Lifecycle
    Requests the shutdown of the application.
    Messages
    Declares an interface of typed messages.
    Observable<T>
    A value that tells its listeners when it changes.
    Property<T>
    An observable value that can be set, from any thread.
    ReadyListener
    Told when the application is ready: once the main window is shown, and the events posted while showing it have run.
    ResourceOpener
    Opens the resources of one package, from the package's own module, so that reading them needs no open package.
    Resources
    The resources of classes: their TOML files, merged along the class hierarchy and across the locale and platform variants, and cached per class and locale.
    Scope
    The disposal list of an application, window or view scope, for what is not a bean.
    ShutdownStep
    A step of the shutdown, contributed with @IntoSet(ShutdownStep.class).
    StartupStep
    A step of the startup, contributed with @IntoSet(StartupStep.class).
    Subscription
    A listener's subscription to an Observable, released when its scope closes or when it is closed.
    Task<T extends @Nullable Object>
    Work that runs on a virtual thread, with its completion hooks.
    TaskContext
    What the work of a Task can tell and ask while it runs: Task.of((TaskContext context) -> ...).
    TaskService
    Runs tasks in a scope, without blocking any input.
    TaskWork<T extends @Nullable Object>
    The work of a Task that uses its TaskContext.
    UiExecutor
    Runs work on the user-interface thread.
